item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Wear your support for Police and Law Enforcement Officials with Rothco's Low Pro Thin Blue Line Cap.
description: The Thin Blue Line is a symbol of respect and support for Police and Law Enforcement Officials; show your support with Rothco's Low Pro Thin Blue Line Cap. The low pro cap features durable 100% brushed cotton twill, hook & loop closure back for an adjustable fit and inner sweatband. A Thin Blue Line flag is embroidered front and center on the cap.
